contract: P38 promised reachable test commands from workflow steps. Comments, names and echo strings do not execute Vitest. Legitimate YAML run commands and shell line continuations do. Lexical workflow-run command context only, no universal shell CFG/remote Actions resolution.

cases.workflow:
jobs:
  test:
    steps:
      - run: npm --prefix packages/core run test:skills

jobs:
  test:
    steps:
      - run: npm --prefix packages/core test --silent -- skills/

jobs:
  test:
    steps:
      - run: npx --prefix packages/core vitest run packages/core/skills/

jobs:
  test:
    steps:
      - run: |
          npx --prefix packages/core vitest run \
            packages/core/skills/

jobs:
  test:
    steps:
      # npm --prefix packages/core run test:skills
      - run: true

jobs:
  test:
    steps:
      - run: |
          # npm --prefix packages/core run test:skills
          true

jobs:
  test:
    steps:
      - run: echo "npm --prefix packages/core run test:skills"

jobs:
  test:
    steps:
      - name: npm --prefix packages/core run test:skills
        run: true
